items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: The white boy, Louis Morgan there, he was the copper, captain of the police force. And he'd say, where Booker T. at?

ctx.x: He just thought called you Booker T.

Well you see, they're around Lindsey Phil and Claymore, they didn't allow them colored fellas to be around there. I was the only colored fellas used to hang up around there because I would come up there and I would work them by Dr. Tudrick, you know. I stayed there. But when them colored fellas would come around there, they'd be fighting and going on, they'd be running them. Well I was the only colored fellas. I'd be in a gang with the white fellas, they'd have to run them too, you know. Though when they'd do me…
